firmware.title: CPH2451_15.0.0.800(EX01) is available
firmware.description:
New version:CPH2451_15.0.0.800(EX01)

A new software update is now available for your Android smartphone.

Apps

• Adds partial screen recording. You can now select a specific area of the screen to record, instead of capturing the entire screen.

Interconnection

• You can now connect your phone to your Mac. You can now view your phone files on your Mac and transfer files between the devices.

System

• Introduces stack view for the Recent tasks screen, which can be turned or off in "Settings - Home screen & Lock screen - Recent tasks manager".

• Enhances gesture recognition for closing floating windows; improves shadow effects around floating windows.

• Integrates the April 2025 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During Installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1

firmware.title: CPH2451_15.0.0.821(EX01) is available
firmware.description:
New Version Available: CPH2451_15.0.0.821(EX01)

A new software update is now available for your Android smartphone.

System •Improves the visuals for individual notifications, notification stacks, and user interactions with these notifications on the Lock screen.
•You can now enter Lock Screen Magazine by swiping right on the Lock screen.
•Adds the Drag & drop feature that allows you to use the gesture to perform actions on images and text in third-party apps. This feature can be turned on or off in "Settings - Accessibility & convenience - Drag & drop".
•The size and position of floating windows are now saved for more convenient usage.
•Redesigns the app drawer for a more consistent visual style, improving usability throughout the interface.
•Improves the user interface and icon designs.
•Improves the user experience of floating windows.
•Integrates the May 2025 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Security & privacy •You can now protect your recently deleted items in the My Files, Notes, and Photos apps with a password for added privacy.
•You can view storage usage by apps and the system when freeing up space using Phone Manager.
•During Screen sharing, you can block specific apps and notifications. This feature is available in "Settings - Security & privacy - Screen sharing protection".

Apps Fixes an issue where photos might be accidentally deleted by a third-party app. When this happens, you will receive a notification to review deleted photos in Recently deleted.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During Installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1
